name: fillet the four vertical edges (picked in the view)
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.run('view:iso'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); await m.run('fillet'); const vp = m.viewport; const r = vp.canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const edges = m.state.partEntry.edgeList.filter((ed) => { const d = ed.tangentAt(0.5); return Math.abs(d.y) > 0.9 * Math.hypot(d.x, d.y, d.z); }); for (const ed of edges) { const p = ed.pointAt(0.5); const s = vp.toScreen([p.x, p.y, p.z]); const hit = vp.pick(s.x + r.left, s.y + r.top, { kinds: ['edge'] }); if (hit) vp.options.onPick(hit, { clientX: s.x + r.left, clientY: s.y + r.top }); } m.actions.pmFieldChanged('radius', '4', 'length'); const n = m.state.editing.feature.edges.length; m.actions.acceptEditing(); return n + ' ' + m.active().features.at(-1).type; })()

name: adv: static simulation of a cantilever gives stresses and a factor of safety
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part'); const part = m.active(); const s = window.__sk({ kind: 'std', name: 'front' }, window.__rect(0, 0, 100, 10)); m.actions.change('op.addFeature', () => { part.features.push({ id: 'ex1', type: 'extrude', name: 'E1', sketch: s, op: 'boss', end: 'blind', depth: 10, reverse: false, end2: 'none', depth2: 10 }); }); await m.run('simulation'); const e = m.state.editing; const entry = m.state.partEntry; const faces = entry.faces.map((f, i) => ({ i, f, c: f.center })); const fix = faces.reduce((a, b) => (b.c.x < a.c.x ? b : a)); const load = faces.reduce((a, b) => (b.c.x > a.c.x ? b : a)); e.fixtures = [{ index: fix.i, faceId: fix.f.hashCode, type: 'PLANE' }]; e.loads = [{ index: load.i, faceId: load.f.hashCode, type: 'PLANE' }]; e.magnitude = 100; e.dir = '-y'; e.resolution = 60; await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); const r = m.state.sim?.result; return r ? `${r.maxStress > 20 && r.maxStress < 90} ${r.maxDisplacement > 0.1 && r.maxDisplacement < 0.3} ${r.minFactorOfSafety > 0}` : 'none'; })()

name: adv: sheet metal base flange + edge flange, then flatten
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part'); window.__sk({ kind: 'std', name: 'top' }, window.__rect(0, 0, 100, 50)); await m.run('baseFlange'); m.actions.acceptEditing(); const entry = m.state.partEntry; const i = entry.edgeList.findIndex((ed) => ed.geomType === 'LINE' && ed.startPoint.x > 99.9 && ed.endPoint.x > 99.9 && ed.startPoint.z > 1.9 && ed.endPoint.z > 1.9); m.actions.select([{ kind: 'edge', bodyKey: 'body', index: i, key: 'edge:body:' + i }]); await m.run('edgeFlange'); m.actions.acceptEditing(); const formed = window.__box(); await m.run('flatten'); const flat = window.__box(); await m.run('flatten'); return [i >= 0, window.__ok(), formed[2] > 20, flat[2] === 2, flat[0] > 124 && flat[0] < 125].join(' '); })()

name: more: simulation: buckling study gives a load factor near Euler
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.run('simulation'); const e = m.state.editing; const entry = m.state.partEntry; const faces = entry.faces.map((f, i) => ({ i, f, c: f.center })); const fix = faces.reduce((a, b) => (b.c.x < a.c.x ? b : a)); const load = faces.reduce((a, b) => (b.c.x > a.c.x ? b : a)); m.actions.pmSet('study', 'buckling'); const html1 = document.querySelector('#left-panel, .left-panel, body').innerHTML; e.fixtures = [{ index: fix.i, faceId: fix.f.hashCode, type: 'PLANE' }]; e.loads = [{ index: load.i, faceId: load.f.hashCode, type: 'PLANE' }]; e.magnitude = 1000; e.dir = '-x'; e.resolution = 40; await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); const r = e.result; const html = document.body.innerHTML; return [html1.includes('data-value="buckling"'), r && r.loadFactor > 9 && r.loadFactor < 14, m.state.sim?.study, html.includes('data-value="0"')].join(' '); })()

name: more: assembly: linear component pattern makes 2 copies that follow the seed
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const a = m.active(); const n0 = a.components.length; const seed = a.components.find((c) => !c.fixed); await m.run('linearComponentPattern'); const e = m.state.editing; e.seeds = [seed.id]; e.count = 3; e.spacing = 200; e.dir = 'z'; m.actions.pmSet('dir', 'z'); m.actions.acceptEditing(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const copies = a.components.filter((c) => c.seed === seed.id); const dz = copies.map((c) => Math.round(c.position[2] - seed.position[2])).join(','); const tree = document.body.innerHTML.includes('data-key="pattern:') || [...document.querySelectorAll('.tree-row')].some((r) => r.textContent.includes('(2)')); return [a.components.length - n0, dz, tree].join(' '); })()

name: more: assembly: circular pattern and mirror

name: more: assembly: smart mate from two picked faces
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.openSampleAsk('shaftAssembly'); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); const a = m.active(); a.mates = []; const [c1, c2] = a.components; const faceOf = (c, type) => { const part = m.project.parts.find((p) => p.id === c.part); const entry = m.actions.buildPart(part); return entry.faces.findIndex((f) => f.geomType === type); }; await m.run('smartMate'); const i1 = faceOf(c1, 'CYLINDRE'); const i2 = faceOf(c2, 'CYLINDRE'); const pick = (c, i) => m.viewport.options.onPick({ kind: 'face', bodyKey: 'comp:' + c.id, index: i }, {}); pick(c1, i1); pick(c2, i2); const t1 = a.mates.map((x) => x.type).join(','); const p1 = faceOf(c1, 'PLANE'); const p2 = faceOf(c2, 'PLANE'); pick(c1, p1); pick(c2, p2); const t2 = a.mates.map((x) => x.type).join(','); m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); return [i1 >= 0 && i2 >= 0, t1, t2].join(' '); })()

name: more: assembly: move with collision detection stops at contact
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('assembly'); const pr = m.project; const partId = 'pbox'; m.actions.change('op.addPart', (p) => { p.parts.push({ id: partId, name: 'Box', features: [{ id: 'sk1', type: 'sketch', name: 'S1', plane: { kind: 'std', name: 'front' }, entities: [{ id: 'O', type: 'point', x: 0, y: 0, fixed: true, origin: true }, ...window.__rect(-5, -5, 5, 5)], constraints: [] }, { id: 'e1', type: 'extrude', name: 'E1', sketch: 'sk1', op: 'boss', end: 'blind', depth: 10, reverse: false, end2: 'none', depth2: 10 }], material: 'steel-1020' }); }); m.actions.insertComponent(partId); m.actions.insertComponent(partId); const a = m.active(); const [c1, c2] = a.components; m.actions.change('op.move', () => { c2.position = [40, 0, 0]; }); await m.run('moveComponent'); const e = m.state.editing; e.seeds = [c2.id]; e.step = 50; await m.actions.pmCommand('more.move:-x'); const x = a.components[1].position[0]; const msg = e.last; m.actions.pmSet('collisionMode', 'highlight'); await m.actions.pmCommand('more.move:-x'); const x2 = a.components[1].position[0]; m.actions.cancelEditing({ quiet: true }); return [msg.stopped, x >= 10 && x < 16, msg.hits.length, x2 < x, m.state.selection.map((s) => s.id).includes(c1.id)].join(' '); })()
